name: @mambalabsdev/mcp-wcag-accessibility-audit
description: MCP server for WCAG Accessibility Audit. Audit any website with axe-core in a real browser and get one row per domain: WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 issues found by automated checks by severity, top failing rules, sample elements, a score, European Accessibility Act exposure signals, and optional accessibility statement, overlay, privacy policy, Impressum, and US privacy choice checks. Runs on Apify. Clay-ready output.
author: Mamba Labs <labs@mambamindsetgrowth.com>
